final: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'No Status') as status, AVG(modelconf) as avg_modelconf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY COALESCE(brokrepstat, 'No Status')), baseline_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as baseline_value FROM status_averages), qualifying_statuses AS (SELECT sa.status, sa.avg_modelconf FROM status_averages sa, baseline_calc bc WHERE sa.avg_modelconf > bc.baseline_value), qualifying_mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) as mean_val FROM qualifying_statuses) SELECT qs.status, qs.avg_modelconf, qs.avg_modelconf - bc.baseline_value as diff_from_baseline, qs.avg_modelconf / qmc.mean_val as ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying_statuses qs, baseline_calc bc, qualifying_mean_calc qmc WHERE bc.baseline_value IS NOT NULL AND qmc.mean_val IS NOT NULL ORDER BY qs.status
